title: Mobile catalog overflows to ~1600px in 6 of 8 categories
problem: Implicit single grid column (catalog-view.tsx:213) sizes to min-content of SubcategoryChips (nowrap row). Content column becomes 943-1715px wide at 390px viewport; product cards, search and sort go off-screen.
solution: Add min-w-0 to the content column div (catalog-view.tsx:230) or grid-cols-1 below lg. Verify 390/430/768/1024.

title: Production Supabase project is empty (0 migrations, no data, no admin)
problem: sofiivkawater-prod has no migrations. Deploying dev with prod keys silently falls back to the bundled catalogue and the admin is unusable; leads are not stored without SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.
solution: Apply 12 migrations, seed products/banners/posts/media, create admin, enable leaked password protection, set env on VPS, document in DEPLOY.md, add a smoke check that the catalogue comes from DB.

title: Infinite redirect loop for signed-in non-staff (e.g. removed employee)
problem: requireStaff redirects to /admin/login?denied=1 (auth.ts:32); proxy redirects signed-in users away from /admin/login to /admin (proxy.ts:36). ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS, no way to sign out.
solution: Do not redirect from /admin/login when denied=1; sign the session out (route handler) and show the login form with the denial message.
statusNote: dac1875 + auth.ts: DB errors no longer treated as denial

title: Cart never revalidates prices/stock; qty unbounded; generic order error; pixel value from stale client total
problem: Price/name snapshot in localStorage is never refreshed (verified: cart shows 2 500 UAH for a 22 450 UAH item). setQty/add have no max while the server rejects qty>20. Any hidden/out-of-stock line returns invalid_items for the whole order with a generic message. Purchase/GenerateLead use client orderTotal.
solution: Refresh lines against current catalogue by SKU on /cart and show changes; clamp qty 1..20; return offending sku from API and highlight it; use data.total for pixel events.

title: Search has no ranking, RU/translit synonyms, stemming or typo tolerance
problem: Token includes() AND match in catalogue order. 'фильтр','железо','соль','кросс','помпа','насос','ecosft' -> 0 results; 'картридж' lists mainline filters first; 'стандарт' returns 48 with FP mechanical filters first; empty state offers nothing.
solution: Weighted scoring (SKU exact > name prefix > name > line/type > facets), RU->UA and Latin<->Cyrillic synonym map, stem prefix match, Damerau-Levenshtein<=1 for tokens>=5, empty state with categories/hits, unit tests on a query list.

title: 'Комплектація' facet ORs independent attributes
problem: kit facet (catalog-facets.ts:214) mixes tank/pump/mineraliser values; OR inside the group returns 5 products for CROSS + 'Без бака' + 'З мінералізатором' instead of 1.
solution: Split into separate boolean facets (tank, pump, mineraliser) so groups AND together; map or drop legacy ?kit= params.

title: Product characteristics are unstructured and inconsistent; not editable in admin
problem: 287 distinct spec labels; 'Продуктивність' in 14 label variants with л/год, м3/год, л/хв and ranges in 4 formats; duplicates like °C vs °С and 'Залізо, мг/л' vs 'Вміст заліза, мг/л'; key spec 'Накопичувальний бак' shows 'без накопичувального бака'/'Без бака'/'Є'/'7 л' (catalog-facets.ts:372); 43 products without specs; no specs/attributes editor in admin.
solution: Attribute registry {key,label,unit,type,order}; normaliser script with mismatch report; typed attributes in DB; PDP specs rendered from registry; admin attribute editor by type.
statusNote: display normalisation, admin editor, data migration 20261007120000 (dev): 44 → 21 duplicate groups, remaining are distinct measures

title: Homepage loads ~3 MB of PNG for 125x200 promo tiles
problem: PromoTile (sections.tsx:100-116) and the HoReCa block (:255) use raw with 1.45-1.67 MB PNG originals (1672x941).
solution: Use next/image with sizes; convert category-scenes-v3 and page-headers to WebP/AVIF <=200 KB.

title: /catalog and /search ship 0.7-0.9 MB of serialized product objects to the client
problem: CatalogView ('use client') receives full Product incl. longDescription/specs/documents. /catalog 897 KB HTML + 697 KB RSC; /search 802 KB and dynamic on every request.
solution: Map to a lean CatalogItem on the server (card + facet fields + keySpecs); make /search static or cached.

title: Bundled catalogue fallback can price orders with stale data
problem: On DB timeout/error/empty response getProducts() returns src/lib/products.ts. It already diverges (SCALEX categories); hidden products reappear; /api/order totals use the same fallback.
solution: No fallback for /api/order (503 or flagged lead); rely on last ISR cache for storefront; alert on empty catalogue; later remove products.ts from runtime.

title: Product editor accepts price 0 and old_price <= price; no concurrency check; no create/archive
problem: saveProduct (actions.ts:164-214) allows price 0 (order API then accepts 0 UAH orders) and any old_price; last write wins; product create/archive/delete, category, brand, specs and documents are not supported.
solution: Validate price>0 (or request CTA) and old_price>price; optimistic concurrency via updated_at; add create/duplicate/soft-archive in Phase 3.
statusNote: 32f9d97 validation/concurrency; c3e72b1 create, duplicate, admin-only delete

title: No error.tsx/global-error.tsx; admin server actions throw to the default Next error screen
problem: updateStaffRole, removeStaff, deleteBanner, deletePost, resetPage, moveCategory, deleteCollection, updateMediaAlt throw; no error boundaries or loading states.
solution: Add app/error.tsx, app/global-error.tsx, admin error.tsx and loading.tsx; return FormState from form actions.

title: Managers can hard-delete catalogue via REST; audit log actor is forgeable; staff changes not audited
problem: RLS grants DELETE on products/posts/pages/collections to any staff; audit_log/lead_events INSERT accepts any actor; addStaff/updateStaffRole/removeStaff/setCategoryHidden/reorders are not logged.
solution: Restrict product DELETE to admin or use soft delete; with check (actor = auth.uid()) or trigger-based audit; log staff changes.

title: Hidden category is only hidden from menus
problem: Category page, its products in /catalog and search, and the sitemap URL remain when is_hidden=true.
solution: notFound() for hidden categories, exclude their products from storefront lists, build sitemap from getStoreCategories().

title: Filtered URLs render unfiltered on the server; price/sort/stock not in URL; no popstate
problem: ?line=CROSS SSR shows 14 then 5 after hydration (CLS); sort/price/inStock/visibleCount lost on reload; replaceState only.
solution: Pass server searchParams as initial state; serialise sort/min/max/stock; listen to popstate.

title: Product JSON-LD brand hardcoded to Ecosoft
problem: BWT/Dowex/Amberlite/Calgon products get brand Ecosoft (page.tsx:185).
solution: brand: productBrand(product).

title: Header drawer, gallery zoom and callback modal lack focus trap / focus restore
problem: Tab escapes the dialogs and focus is lost on close; only the catalog filter drawer is correct.
solution: Extract the filter drawer logic into a useDialogFocus hook and reuse it.

title: White text on primary buttons is 3.95:1 (fails WCAG AA)
problem: Купити / До кошика / Знайти / Каталог at 14px on #007FF2; 'Передзвоніть мені' 3.59:1.
solution: Darken the button background token to ~#006BD6 (>=4.5:1).

title: Rate limit is in-memory and trusts spoofable cf-connecting-ip
problem: Origin IP is public; requests that bypass Cloudflare can set any cf-connecting-ip and evade limits, spamming the DB and Telegram.
solution: Restrict origin to Cloudflare ranges in Nginx (real_ip_from), drop untrusted headers, add a per-phone limit.

title: No confirmation for revoking staff; addStaff ignores password for existing users and can change own role; no unsaved-changes guard
problem: 'Закрити доступ' is one click; addStaff upsert bypasses the self-demotion check; forms lose edits on navigation.
solution: Confirm dialog; distinct message and self-role guard in addStaff; useUnsavedChanges hook.

title: Media usage check misses page sections, post bodies and menus
problem: Only top-level site_pages.content.image is inspected; files still in use can be deleted.
solution: Recursive URL search in content jsonb and post body.

title: Leaked password protection disabled; no MFA for admins
problem: Supabase advisor warning on dev; prod not configured.
solution: Enable in both projects; consider TOTP MFA for the admin role.

title: 50 products have image set but images[] empty
problem: Denormalised photo data; UI compensates but feeds/CRM may diverge.
solution: One-off update images = [image]; derive image from images[0].
statusNote: catalog_integrity applied on dev (prod pending with ECO-002)

title: Integrity rules live only in code
problem: products.category has no FK to categories; no CHECK old_price>price / price>0; sku nullable; reorder actions run N non-transactional updates.
solution: Migration with FK + CHECKs + sku not null; reorder via a transactional RPC.
statusNote: catalog_integrity applied on dev; reorder RPC not done

title: Low-coverage facets hide products with missing data
problem: Лінійка 12/46 (filtration-systems), Типорозмір 7/18 (mainline-filters), GPD 3/37, period 18/37, micron 19/36.
solution: Fill data (with ECO-007) or hide facets under ~60% coverage.
statusNote: data gap (e.g. series filled for 12/46 systems) — needs product data, not code

title: No generated Supabase types; 860-line actions.ts; duplicated validators
problem: Untyped queries, 'as unknown as' casts (actions.ts:130, collections/page.tsx:15), email regex in 3 places, two transliteration helpers.
solution: supabase gen types + Database generic; split actions by domain; shared validators.

title: 404 page uses the homepage title
problem: Unknown URLs render the default site title.
solution: Add metadata title 'Сторінку не знайдено'.

title: 'Проточні фільтри' is a top-level category with a single product
problem: A prominent nav item and homepage promo tile lead to one product.
solution: Merge or populate.

title: Header phone shown unformatted (+380504478676)
problem: Hard to read.
solution: Format via toPhoneContacts.
statusNote: phone shown exactly as entered in admin (commit 0966a20 intent)

title: First PDP thumbnail requests w=384 for a 78px slot
problem: Inconsistent sizes between thumbnails.
solution: Use sizes='80px' for all thumbnails.

title: Admin products limited to 500 rows without pagination; customers aggregate 5000 leads in memory
problem: Will silently truncate as data grows; no bulk actions.
solution: Server pagination via range(); bulk price/stock actions later.

title: Price facet shows Infinity on an empty product set
problem: Math.min()/max() of [] at catalog-view.tsx:202-203.
solution: Guard products.length.

title: Ad scripts rendered in admin (blocked by CSP, noisy console)
problem: Pixel/GTM tags are emitted and then blocked.
solution: Move the storefront into a route group layout that renders tracking; keep the admin layout clean.
statusNote: CSP already blocks the tags in /admin; moving the storefront into a route group is churn for little gain

title: Callback modal refocuses phone input when parent re-renders
problem: onClose in effect deps (callback-button.tsx:79).
solution: useEffectEvent or a ref for onClose.

title: README is the create-next-app template
problem: No env/Supabase/admin documentation.
solution: Short README with env table and local setup.
